_comment: Optional telecom employers whose own careers feed is read directly (same format and ATS support as the main board's config/employers.json: greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters, workable, recruitee, personio, workday). Board ids are NOT guessed here. Add a line after checking the employer's careers page, e.g. { "name": "Acme Telecom", "ats": "workday", "host": "acme.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com", "site": "Careers", "country": "GB", "local": true }. Failing employers are listed on the page under Source status.
